classification.occupancy_display: DERIVED_DISPLAY_CONVERSION: native observed V2 ratio multiplied by 100; not a reconstructed occupancy metric
classification.activity_hours: DERIVED_DISPLAY_CONVERSION: native seconds divided by 3600 for chart labeling

occupancy.validation: Raw value between 0 and 1; matches native contact time / (contact time + idle time) at identical instance, routing-profile scope, interval and AGENT dimension when denominator is positive. Refuse publication if scale changes.

scope: Contact and routing-response metrics: VOICE, all enumerated STANDARD queues, all initiation methods. Occupancy and agent activity time: all enumerated routing profiles, all channels, no queue filter. These scopes must remain separate.

warehouse.key: instance_id + metric_spec_hash + scope_hash + interval_start + interval_end + interval_period + dimensions_hash
warehouse.identity: Join Dimensions.AGENT to dim_connect_user on instance_id + user_id, normalizing an ARN to its user ID if necessary. Preserve username and effective-dated identity history. Names are display attributes, never join keys.
warehouse.native: Select the returned native value at its complete request key. Do not average agent averages or occupancy percentages into team totals; retrieve native ungrouped TOTAL instead.
warehouse.snapshot: Keep GetCurrentUserData in fct_connect_user_snapshot keyed by instance_id + user_id + retrieval_timestamp. This is a point-in-time response, not historical availability or a staffing schedule.
warehouse.refresh: Preserve immutable raw request/response evidence; upsert latest interval result by its complete key. Missing, explicit zero and API errors remain distinct. Re-pull completed dates for late records.
warehouse.security: Permission agent identities and coaching views by role. No customer names, phone numbers, recordings or transcripts in this dashboard. Snowflake execution and access controls have not been deployed by this local prototype.

metrics.label: Contacts handled
metrics.meaning: Agent-connected voice contact legs, attributed by Amazon's historical contact-record reporting. Includes inbound, outbound and transfer legs; not unique callers or a count of human customer answers.

metrics.label: Agent non-response
metrics.meaning: Routing attempts an agent did not answer. One contact may create several attempts. Investigate technical and routing conditions before using this for coaching.

metrics.label: Non-response excluding customer abandons
metrics.meaning: Native non-response count excluding attempts where the customer abandoned while connecting to the agent. Do not subtract handled contacts from this measure.

metrics.label: Agent answer rate
metrics.meaning: Amazon's percentage of routing attempts answered by an agent. It is not the percentage of incoming customers who reached an agent. Preserve the native rate rather than reconstructing an offer denominator from contact counts.

metrics.label: Average handle time
metrics.meaning: Native average handling time, including interaction, customer hold and after-contact work for eligible voice contacts. Lower is not automatically better; review contact complexity and quality.

metrics.label: Average interaction time
metrics.meaning: Native average agent interaction duration. Excludes customer hold and after-contact work; do not average agents' averages to obtain the team result.

metrics.label: Average customer hold time
metrics.meaning: Native average customer hold duration under Amazon's eligibility rules. Queue waiting before answer is not agent hold time. Its denominator need not match interaction time.

metrics.label: Average after-contact work
metrics.meaning: Native average wrap-up duration after interaction. Amazon includes zero for certain connected contacts without a recorded after-contact-work duration. Do not substitute a naive average of nullable record fields.

metrics.label: Occupancy
metrics.meaning: Native share of contact and idle time spent on contacts. This routing-profile measure spans eligible channel activity; it is not a voice-only queue metric or schedule adherence.

metrics.label: Online time
metrics.meaning: Total agent time in statuses other than Offline, under Amazon's activity rules. Not a roster headcount or proof of adherence to a published schedule.

metrics.label: Agent contact time
metrics.meaning: Native agent activity time spent on contacts, including applicable hold and wrap-up. Activity while in custom or Offline statuses has separate treatment; do not reconstruct this by adding contact-record durations.

metrics.label: Idle time
metrics.meaning: Native time available without handling contacts, including applicable connecting and error time. Idle time is not automatically wasted time; demand and staffing context matter.

metrics.label: Custom-status time
metrics.meaning: Time in custom agent statuses, using Amazon's non-productive-time definition. A custom status can represent necessary meetings or other assigned work; the label is not a performance judgment.

metrics.label: Schedule adherence
metrics.meaning: Native adherence to published schedules where workforce scheduling is configured and supported. No result means unavailable, not zero adherence.

metrics.label: Weighted evaluation score
metrics.meaning: Native weighted evaluation score where completed evaluations exist. Compare compatible evaluation forms and versions; do not treat mixed-form aggregates as a fair agent ranking.
